bibl.title: Μισούμενα on the Misoumenos: Neglected Tables of Fractions in P.Oxy. XXXIII 2656.
bibl.seg: Giuseppina Azzarello, Μισούμενα on the Misoumenos: Neglected Tables of Fractions in P.Oxy. XXXIII 2656.
bibl.note: Offers the (re)edition of five tables of parts (1/12, 1/13, 1/14, 1/15, 1/16), contained in P.Oxy. XXXIII 2656, the famous codex of Menander's Misoumenos and only partially (table of 1/13) edited so far. The palaeographical and content-related analysis of the tables, turn out to be fundamental for a better understanding of the codex's chronology and context.
